title: Headers across the first row
motivation: Column headings give dates, activities, and rooms their context.

title: Headers down the first column
motivation: The same information can be read across rows, with a heading at the start of each row.

title: Headers in both directions
motivation: An available-place count needs both a time and a weekday to be meaningful.

title: Offset row headers: a current limitation
motivation: A name can identify a row even when an identifier occupies the first column.
limitation: Limitation: automatic row-header associations currently cover the first column only. Volunteer names in the second column have no generated row scope or data-cell associations. This is an editable test case, not a recommended published pattern.

title: Grouped columns and three header contexts
motivation: Each number belongs to a room, a building, and a session. Spanning headers show the building groups.

value.caption: Room availability by building
value.description: The first two rows describe buildings and sessions. The first column names rooms; numbers are available places.

title: Headers spanning several rows
motivation: A shared site heading can identify several session rows. This renderer links spanning edge headers with generated headers attributes rather than emitting rowgroup or colgroup scope.

title: Headers changing midway: a current limitation
motivation: Repeating a header band can change the meaning of columns halfway through a table. The next two examples separate the topics instead.
limitation: Limitation: automatic column associations use leading header rows only. Interior header bands are retained, but their intended relationships are not inferred. The initial Measure heading remains associated with later data. Use separate tables below instead.

title: Simpler alternative: room capacity
motivation: Separate tables let each topic have its own caption and unambiguous column headings.

title: Simpler alternative: room facilities
motivation: This companion table presents the second topic without an interior header band.

title: A caption identifies; a summary orients
motivation: The caption names the information. The summary explains its arrangement without repeating that name; our Summary field renders visible text linked with aria-describedby.

value.caption: Available places for community groups
value.description: Venue names are in the first column. North yard occupies two rows, one for each workshop space. Other columns compare weekday and weekend places.

title: Separate values and align numbers
motivation: Give item, size, and stock separate cells. Text labels align left; numeric headings and counts align right. Test zoom and narrow screens without removing header relationships.
